correctness.rationale: For X^3Y+Y^3Z+Z^3X, the displayed differential equations imply smoothness for odd p !=7. The base line X+Y+Z restricts to -(X^2+XY+Y^2)^2; Klein matrices D,H,T preserve the quartic projectively. Independently constructed the full orbit of exactly 28 cyclotomic integral lines, verified T^2=-7I and F(Tv)=49F(v), then computed all six Galois cycle profiles. Recomputed every pairwise coordinate-norm resultant gcd (378 pairs), showing possible collisions only at primes 2,7,29,43,71; at 29,43,71 each of six seventh-root embeddings retains 28 distinct lines. Thus all allowed odd-prime reductions remain distinct; the classical 28-bitangent theorem gives completeness and unramified Frobenius action gives the four cycle types. Independent direct prime-field bitangent counts at p=3,5,11,13,29 were 1,1,1,4,28, agreeing.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the universal mathematical proof.
